title: IncreGPUSTA: GPU-Accelerated Incremental Static Timing Analysis for Iterative Design Flows
problem: Combining GPU acceleration with incremental STA is challenging; existing solutions offer only partial incrementality, either reverting to CPU for small modifications or ignoring structural updates.
motivation: Static timing analysis is essential for VLSI optimization but can be computationally expensive; efficient incremental analysis with GPU acceleration would speed design iterations.
method: GPU-accelerated incremental STA algorithm using dual-CSR data structures and incremental levelization to efficiently process timing updates for both localized modifications and structural circuit changes.
key_novelty: First GPU-accelerated incremental STA supporting both localized timing updates and structural modifications with dual-CSR optimization.
contributions: Dual-CSR data structures for efficient GPU incremental processing
Incremental levelization algorithm supporting structural modifications

metrics.speedup: 3.06× over GPU full Timer, 72.50× over CPU incremental Timer

limitations: Evaluated only on industrial benchmarks; scalability to very large designs unclear.
